privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: How Huutopussi ({{site}}) handles your personal data. The service is built to collect as little as possible: it uses no cookies and does not track you across sites.
privacy.controllerB: The data controller is {{org}} ({{site}}). For any privacy matter you can contact {{email}}.
privacy.dataIntro: If you sign in with Google, we store:
privacy.dataGoogle: Your Google account's stable identifier, plus your name shortened to “First L.” and the URL of your profile picture.
privacy.dataNickname: The nickname you choose yourself (when playing as a guest).
privacy.dataElo: Your skill rating (Elo) and the results of the matches you play.
privacy.dataToken: A technical identifier for your sign-in session (only its hash, never the identifier itself).
privacy.dataNone: We do not store your email address or your IP address, and we do not profile you or track you across sites. For counting visitors we use a cookieless analytics that does not identify you (see “Visitor analytics”).
privacy.purposeB: We process this data to run the game: to maintain your account and to show your skill level and match history. The legal basis is the provision of the service (contract). For counting visitors the legal basis is our legitimate interest (see “Visitor analytics”). Signing in is optional — you can also play as a guest without an account.
privacy.thirdIntro: We use the following service providers:
privacy.thirdGoogle: Google — Google Sign-In and displaying your profile picture. When you sign in, Google also processes your data under its own terms.
privacy.thirdFly: Fly.io — server infrastructure (data centre in Stockholm, EU).
privacy.thirdCloudflare: Cloudflare — traffic delivery, protection, and cookieless visitor analytics.
privacy.cookiesB: The service sets no cookies and uses no tracking cookies — our visitor analytics is cookieless too — so no cookie banner is needed. We keep only strictly functional data in your browser's local storage, such as your sign-in token, nickname and language choice. The Google Sign-In script — and any Google cookies — load only once you begin signing in.
privacy.analyticsB: To see how many people visit the site, we use Cloudflare Web Analytics. It is cookieless: it stores nothing in your browser, does not identify you, builds no profile of you and does not track you across other sites. We only ever see aggregate visitor counts. Cloudflare briefly processes your request — including your IP address — to count the visit, but does not store it in a form that identifies you to us, and may process data outside the EU under appropriate safeguards (EU Standard Contractual Clauses). The legal basis is our legitimate interest in tracking visitor numbers and improving the service. You can object to this processing by contacting {{email}}. Because the analytics is cookieless, no separate consent is required.
privacy.retentionB: Your account data is kept until you delete your account. The sign-in token expires after 90 days, and per-match event logs are removed 30 days after a match ends.
privacy.rightsAccess: access the data we hold about you,
privacy.rightsErase: delete your account and data (“right to be forgotten”),
privacy.rightsPortability: download your data in a machine-readable format,
privacy.rightsComplaint: lodge a complaint with the data protection authority (tietosuoja.fi).
privacy.deletionB: You can delete your whole account at any time from your profile page. Deletion permanently removes your account, skill rating and match history, and your name is removed from past matches. It does not affect other players' data.
privacy.ageB: The service is not directed at children under {{age}}. We recommend a minimum age of {{age}}, which also matches the Finnish age of consent for data processing.
privacy.contactB: We may update this policy from time to time. For any privacy matter or to exercise your rights, contact us:

rulesPage.title: Huutopussi rules
rulesPage.intro: Huutopussi is a Finnish trick-taking game. Here's how it works — and the exact rules played here.

objective.title: Objective
objective.body: Win points with tricks and marriages. A match runs over several deals, and the first side to reach the win target (usually 500) wins.

cards.title: The cards
cards.body: A 36-card deck — each suit has the ace, ten, king, queen, jack and 9 down to 6. The ten is second-highest: it beats the king. Aces, tens and court cards score points; low cards don't.

bidding.title: Bidding
bidding.body: Players take turns bidding how many points they promise to make. The highest bid wins, and that player becomes the declarer, who sets the trump suit by declaring a marriage.

exchange.title: Exchange & talon
exchange.body: In the 4-player game the declarer receives cards from their partner and returns the same number. With 2–3 players the declarer takes the talon and sets spare cards aside.

play.title: Playing tricks
play.body: You must follow the led suit and beat the highest card on the table if you can. Trumps beat every other suit. The highest card takes the trick and leads the next one.

marriage.title: Marriages & declaring
marriage.body: A king and queen of the same suit form a marriage. After winning a trick you may declare one: it scores that suit's value and makes it the trump suit.

scoring.title: Scoring & winning
scoring.body: At the end of a deal you count card points, the last-trick bonus and any declared marriages. The declarer succeeds by reaching their bid — otherwise they take a penalty. Points carry deal to deal until someone reaches the win target.

learn.menuIntro: A guided walkthrough plus practice puzzles — learn Huutopussi step by step against bots. Works offline.
learn.tutorialDesc: Play one full deal from start to finish. The game guides you at every step with big instructions on what to do and why.
learn.homeDesc: New here? Learn the rules with a guided deal or practice with puzzles.

common.act: Your turn — tap the highlighted option.
common.wait: Wait — the others are taking their turns.
common.bidding: Bidding. Weigh your hand. With a strong hand you should BID (tap Bid and offer). Otherwise pass.
common.exchangeGive: Your partner is passing you cards. Hang on a moment.
common.exchangeReturn: You got cards from your partner. Pick the same number to give back — keep the strong ones, return the weak.
common.exchangeContract: Commit to a score (the contract). Tap the highlighted amount — at least your bid.
common.exchangeDiscard: You took the talon. Discard the extra cards (no aces or tens).
common.awaitWholeAnswer: You're being asked about a marriage. Answer by tapping a suit if you hold the pair.
common.lead: You lead the trick. If you hold the KING and QUEEN of a suit, you can announce the marriage (tap Announce) — it scores points and switches trump. Otherwise play a card.
common.follow: Follow the led suit if you can. Greyed cards aren't allowed: you must beat the highest card when you can (head-trick rule).

done.tutorialBody: You played a full deal. Now you know the phases: bidding, exchange, declarations, tricks and scoring. Try the puzzles or a real game!

scenarioDesc.bidding: A strong hand — learn to bid and win the auction.
scenarioDesc.marriage: King + queen in hand — declare the marriage for points.
scenarioDesc.trick: Follow suit and beat the highest — take the majority of tricks.
scenarioDesc.endgame: A dominant hand — try to take EVERY trick.

tutorial.goal: Tutorial: play a deal from start to finish, following the hints.

bidding.goal: Goal: win the auction and become the declarer.
bidding.doneWin: You won the auction and became the declarer. That's exactly how to use a strong hand!
bidding.doneLose: You didn't become the declarer. Remember to bid (Bid) right on your turn with a strong hand.

marriage.doneWin: You declared the marriage and scored its points. Always declare when you lead a trick and hold the pair!
marriage.doneLose: The marriage went undeclared. When you lead a trick and hold the K and Q of a suit, tap Announce.

trick.goal: Goal: take at least 5 of the 9 tricks.
trick.doneWin: You took the majority of tricks! Following suit and beating high pays off.
trick.doneLose: Too few tricks. Play high cards and trump in when you can.

endgame.goal: Goal: take EVERY trick (a clean sweep)!
endgame.doneWin: CLEAN SWEEP! You took every trick. With a dominant hand, lead your highest card.
endgame.doneLose: The sweep slipped away this time. Always lead your strongest card and don't let an opponent in.
